Wait, line 132: `enabled: !!profileData && !currentUser.isOwnerOrAdmin,`
But `currentUser` is defined at line 135. This is a React hooks ordering issue - using `currentUser` before it's defined. In JavaScript/TypeScript, this works due to hoisting/closure, but it's bad practice. Actually in React, hooks can read variables defined later in the same component because they're captured in closures. But it's still a code smell.
